```{r}
#| label: setup
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(targets)

summary <- tar_read(prepared_summary_all)
flags <- tar_read(prepared_flags_all)
audit <- tar_read(analysis_row_audit)
dropped <- tar_read(rows_dropped_all)
codebook <- tar_read(derived_codebook)
manifest <- tar_read(data_manifest)

fmt <- function(x) format(x, big.mark = ",", trim = TRUE)
pct <- function(x) sprintf("%.1f%%", 100 * x)
by_id <- function(tbl) arrange(tbl, as.numeric(dataset_id))
theme_set(theme_minimal(base_size = 10))
```

The preparation step turns each dataset's harmonised rows into the tables the models read.
This report shows what it did, so that no row disappears silently.
Data: `r nrow(manifest)` datasets, overall hash `r unique(manifest$overall_hash)`.

## Rows kept and dropped

```{r}
#| label: rows
rows_in <- sum(manifest$primary_rows)
reason_labels <- c(
  age_missing = "No recorded age",
  age_over_limit = "Aged 19 or over",
  trial_arm_after_baseline = "Trial: intervention arm after baseline"
)
bind_rows(
  tibble::tibble(Rows = "Observations before the rules", n = rows_in, datasets = nrow(manifest)),
  dropped |>
    summarise(n = sum(n), datasets = n_distinct(dataset_id), .by = reason) |>
    transmute(Rows = paste("Dropped:", coalesce(reason_labels[reason], reason)), n, datasets),
  tibble::tibble(Rows = "Kept", n = sum(summary$rows_kept), datasets = sum(summary$rows_kept > 0))
) |>
  mutate(Share = pct(n / rows_in), n = fmt(n)) |>
  knitr::kable(col.names = c("", "Observations", "Datasets", "Share"), align = "lrrr")
```

```{r}
#| label: rows-by-dataset
summary |>
  mutate(
    dropped = dropped_age_missing + dropped_age_over_limit + dropped_trial_arm,
    share = dropped / (dropped + rows_kept)
  ) |>
  filter(share > 0.05) |>
  arrange(desc(share)) |>
  transmute(
    Dataset = dataset_id,
    Kept = fmt(rows_kept),
    `No age` = fmt(dropped_age_missing),
    `19 or over` = fmt(dropped_age_over_limit),
    `Trial arm` = fmt(dropped_trial_arm),
    `Share dropped` = pct(share)
  ) |>
  knitr::kable(align = "lrrrrr", caption = "Datasets that lose more than 5% of their observations.")
```

## Total screen time

```{r}
#| label: total
tibble::tibble(
  ` ` = c(
    "Datasets with a total from a dedicated item",
    "Datasets with a summed total",
    "Datasets with both, in different waves",
    "Datasets with no total",
    "Observations with a dedicated total",
    "Observations with a summed total",
    "Summed totals capped at 24 hours",
    "Observations with watching and gaming but no sum, because another activity row is missing"
  ),
  Value = c(
    sum(summary$total_dedicated > 0),
    sum(summary$total_summed > 0),
    sum(summary$total_dedicated > 0 & summary$total_summed > 0),
    sum(summary$total_dedicated == 0 & summary$total_summed == 0),
    fmt(sum(summary$total_dedicated)),
    fmt(sum(summary$total_summed)),
    paste0(fmt(sum(summary$total_capped)), " (", pct(sum(summary$total_capped) / sum(summary$total_summed)), ")"),
    fmt(sum(summary$total_lost_to_incomplete))
  )
) |>
  knitr::kable()
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-total
#| fig-height: 3.5
#| fig-cap: "Median summed total by the number of activity rows a dataset sums. Each point is a dataset."
summary |>
  filter(total_summed > 0) |>
  ggplot(aes(factor(total_coverage_max), total_median_summed)) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.15, height = 0, alpha = 0.6) +
  labs(x = "Activity rows summed (most in any wave)", y = "Median total, hours a day")
```

```{r}
#| label: total-both
summary |>
  filter(total_dedicated > 0 | total_summed > 0) |>
  by_id() |>
  transmute(
    Dataset = dataset_id,
    Dedicated = fmt(total_dedicated),
    Summed = fmt(total_summed),
    `Rows summed` = total_coverage_max,
    Capped = fmt(total_capped),
    `Lost to incomplete rows` = fmt(total_lost_to_incomplete),
    `Median, dedicated` = signif(total_median_dedicated, 3),
    `Median, summed` = signif(total_median_summed, 3)
  ) |>
  knitr::kable(align = "lrrrrrrr")
```

## What happened to each row

```{r}
#| label: audit-status
status_labels <- c(
  used = "Used",
  derived = "Derived from its parts and used",
  dropped_repeat = "Dropped: repeats another row's score",
  dropped_part = "Dropped: part of a whole in the same node",
  dropped_preferred = "Dropped: letter grades where numeric grades exist",
  excluded = "Excluded by a dataset exception",
  archive = "Not analysed this round (archive)",
  descriptive_only = "Described only (nominal)"
)
audit |>
  summarise(
    cells = n(),
    datasets = n_distinct(dataset_id),
    variables = n_distinct(variable_name),
    .by = c(kind, status)
  ) |>
  arrange(kind, desc(cells)) |>
  transmute(Kind = kind, Status = coalesce(status_labels[status], status), `Dataset, wave and row cells` = fmt(cells), Datasets = datasets, `Schema rows` = variables) |>
  knitr::kable(align = "llrrr")
```

### Repeats found

```{r}
#| label: repeats
audit |>
  filter(status == "dropped_repeat") |>
  summarise(datasets = n_distinct(dataset_id), waves = n(), .by = c(variable_name, detail)) |>
  arrange(variable_name) |>
  transmute(`Row dropped` = variable_name, Reason = detail, Datasets = datasets, `Dataset-waves` = waves) |>
  knitr::kable(align = "llrr")
```

### Derivations run

```{r}
#| label: derived
audit |>
  filter(status == "derived") |>
  summarise(datasets = n_distinct(dataset_id), n = sum(n_used), .by = variable_name) |>
  arrange(variable_name) |>
  transmute(Row = variable_name, Datasets = datasets, Values = fmt(n)) |>
  knitr::kable(align = "lrr")
```

### Values dropped at the plausibility limits

```{r}
#| label: limits
audit |>
  filter(status %in% c("used", "derived"), n_values > n_used) |>
  summarise(dropped = sum(n_values - n_used), values = sum(n_values), datasets = n_distinct(dataset_id), .by = c(kind, variable_name)) |>
  mutate(share = dropped / values) |>
  arrange(desc(dropped)) |>
  head(40) |>
  transmute(Kind = kind, Row = variable_name, Dropped = fmt(dropped), Share = pct(share), Datasets = datasets) |>
  knitr::kable(align = "llrrr", caption = "The 40 rows with most values dropped.")
```

## Flags to resolve

Each flag ends in an analysis exception, a harmonisation fix or no action.

```{r}
#| label: flag-summary
flag_labels <- c(
  derive_at_analysis = "Mapping note says derive at analysis, but no rule ran",
  near_identical = "Two outcome rows correlate above 0.98",
  measure_changes = "More than one instrument within a wave",
  out_of_bounds = "More than 5% of a row's values outside the bounds",
  total_incomplete = "Summed total lost to incomplete activity rows",
  rows_dropped = "More than a fifth of observations dropped"
)
flags |>
  summarise(flags = n(), datasets = n_distinct(dataset_id), .by = flag) |>
  arrange(desc(flags)) |>
  transmute(Flag = coalesce(flag_labels[flag], flag), Flags = flags, Datasets = datasets) |>
  knitr::kable(align = "lrr")
```

`r nrow(manifest) - n_distinct(flags$dataset_id)` of `r nrow(manifest)` datasets have no flag.

```{r}
#| label: flag-list
flags |>
  by_id() |>
  transmute(Dataset = dataset_id, Flag = flag, Row = coalesce(variable_name, ""), Detail = detail) |>
  knitr::kable()
```

## One line per dataset

```{r}
#| label: per-dataset
summary |>
  by_id() |>
  left_join(count(flags, dataset_id, name = "flags"), by = "dataset_id") |>
  transmute(
    Dataset = dataset_id,
    Kept = fmt(rows_kept),
    Participants = fmt(participants),
    Units = units,
    Exposures = exposures_used,
    Outcomes = outcomes_used,
    Derived = outcomes_derived,
    Repeats = outcomes_dropped_repeat,
    Parts = outcomes_dropped_part,
    Archive = outcomes_archive,
    `Extra measure rows` = fmt(measure_rows),
    Flags = coalesce(flags, 0L)
  ) |>
  knitr::kable(align = "lrrrrrrrrrrr")
```

## Derived variables

```{r}
#| label: codebook
codebook |>
  transmute(Variable = variable, Table = table, Definition = definition, Source = source) |>
```
